name: @adatechnology/weather-test-area
description: Weather area for the shared test room: any weather of the game-weather registry (clear to typhoon) with an instant or 10 s blend, the hour of the day, the automatic climate schedule at 600x, the seed, the weather written into host.environment and the scene fog, and the numbers a game reads from it (rain, visibility, sight and hearing scale, wind, heat index, wet ground, lightning strikes).
